text.p: Borussia Dortmund beat Juventus 3-1 (halftime 2-0) in the final of the European Cup at the Olympic Stadium on Wednesday.

Juventus: 1-Angelo Peruzzi; 2-Ciro Ferrara, 4-Paolo Montero, 5-Sergio Porrini (10-Alessandro Del Piero 46), 13-Mark Juliano, 7-Angelo Di Livio, 14-Didier Deschamps, 21-Zinedine Zidane, 18-Vladimir Jugovic, 9-Alen Boksic (20-Alessio Tachinardi 86), 15-Christian Vieri (16-Nicola Amoruso 73)

Borussia Dortmund: 1-Stefan Klos; 6-Matthias Sammer, 16-Martin Kree, 15-Juergen Kohler, 7-Stefan Reuter, 19-Paulo Sousa, 14-Paul Lambert, 17-Joerg Heinrich, 10-Andreas Moeller (8-Michael Zorc 89), 9-Stephane Chapuisat (18-Lars Ricken 70), 13-Karlheinz Reidle (11-Heiko Herrlich 67)
